comparison.objective: Assemble three gears on shafts while finding compatible tooth phases by contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Shaft alignment, insertion, rotational phase search through contact, seating, and release.
comparison.success_condition: All gears seated within 2 mm, 1 mm height, and 3 degrees, mutually meshed, still, and arms clear for one second. Tooth or shaft damage is not explicitly graded.
comparison.reason: Gear phase alignment and shaft insertion are different from orientation-dependent passage of loose media through a screen.
